headline: KB Securities: 'APR Falls Short of Q3 Expectations Due to Exchange Rate and Logistics Cost Burdens; Target Price Maintained'
summary: KB Securities expects APR's third-quarter operating profit to fall short of market expectations due to a weaker exchange rate and rising European logistics costs. It maintained its target price.
why: APR is a South Korean cosmetics maker with global sales, so currency swings and shipping costs directly affect its margins.
